findings: qwen3.7-plus reaches 169/174 exercises (97.1%) against Sonnet's 167 (96.0%) at /bin/zsh.0030 a page, 2.5x cheaper; two exercises on 65 tab pages and one run each is within noise, so read it as level, not better. It is slow: 52 s a page with its thinking.

syt p109 is missed by all five verdicts and p110 by three (Sonnet, qwen3-vl-plus, qwen3.7-plus): pick-direction marks over a tab are read as strum notation. One prompt line would help every model more than switching.

qwen3-vl-plus is the cheapest (/bin/zsh.0005 a page) but answers kind prose with tab regions (heavy-metal p011, sample-arranging p001, syt p115): route only reads regions of a mixed page, so those exercises are dropped. Marks F1 77%.
deepseek-flash never sends a page without tab (precision 100%) but misses 12 exercises, calling tab 'other' on three sample-arranging pages and syt p035.
qwen3.7-flash misses the most (17, recall 90.2%) and is the slowest at 103 s a page.
Spend by the balance tool: DeepSeek CNY 1.55 (estimate 1.60); Alibaba Cloud showed only CNY 0.14 taken against about 1.1 estimated, so its billing lags or a free quota covered it.
findings_zh: qwen3.7-plus 覆盖 169/174 道练习（97.1%），Sonnet 是 167（96.0%），每页 /bin/zsh.0030，便宜 2.5 倍；65 个 tab 页、各跑一次，差 2 道在误差内，应读作持平而非更好。它慢：带思考每页 52 秒。
syt p109 五个结论全漏，p110 漏了三个（Sonnet、qwen3-vl-plus、qwen3.7-plus）：tab 上方的拨弦方向记号被读成扫弦谱。在提示词里加一句，比换模型对所有模型都更有用。
qwen3-vl-plus 最便宜（每页 /bin/zsh.0005），但会给出 kind=prose 却带 tab 区域（heavy-metal p011、sample-arranging p001、syt p115）：route 只读 mixed 页的区域，这些练习就丢了。标记 F1 77%。
deepseek-flash 从不把没有 tab 的页送去读（精确率 100%），但漏 12 道，在三个 sample-arranging 页和 syt p035 上把 tab 判为 other。
qwen3.7-flash 漏得最多（17 道，召回 90.2%），也最慢，每页 103 秒。
余额工具核对：DeepSeek 实扣 ¥1.55（估算 1.60）；阿里云只显示扣了 ¥0.14，估算约 ¥1.1，账单有延迟或被免费额度抵扣。
